hypotheses.rule: fade an absolute open-to-close body >=2 prior body sigmas when volume >=2 prior median

hypotheses.mechanism: gradual incorporation of information and persistent demand
hypotheses.rule: follow body >=1 prior sigma with close in matching outer20percent of range and volume >=2 prior median

hypotheses.mechanism: low-participation range breakout lacks broad demand
hypotheses.rule: fade close outside prior20-session high-low range when volume < prior median

hypotheses.mechanism: high activity in compressed range precedes inventory repricing; speculative OHLCV proxy
hypotheses.rule: follow matching body and outer20percent close when range <=0.5 prior median and volume >=2 prior median

control: same price rule and source eligibility, remove only volume ratio filter

execution.weight_rule: sum last5 same-contract raw directions divided by5, times0.3; daily rebalance
execution.entry: next factual open; cancel signal if decision age exceeds7calendar days
execution.terminal: flat at last active-map effective date of each era

limitations: four competing hypotheses on already-seen development eras, not independent holdout
volume is historical completed daily aggregate, not aggressor flow or order-book depth
stock-market papers motivate hypotheses, not demonstrated MOEX futures profitability
body uses close/open, not total close-to-close return; overnight component not a feature
same-contract warmup and gap resets may substantially reduce coverage, especially BR
five overlapping decision tranches are netted and daily rebalanced, not five independent fixed-quantity trades
daily-open execution and historical specs/fees/margin are research proxies, not broker-exact
controls may have different exposure/turnover; no post-outcome risk matching or control promotion
no sign/window/threshold/asset/leverage selection after seeing this batch
